batting.name: R Sathish
batting.dismissal: c CH Morris b DJ Bravo

balls.text: that's the end of the innings. Awana missed the swing for the fourth time and this time Praveen tried to run a bye to Dhoni, who was keeping without his right glove so that he could throw quickly and accurately. He hit the stumps direct, running out Praveen Kumar
short of a length, pitching in line with the stumps and angling across. Awana backs away again and swings, but misses for the third time
similar ball, similar shot, and similar result. Awana backed away and swished outside off stump
Awana backs away and has a slog as the short of a length ball from over the wicket slants across him, he makes no contact
Praveen moves towards the off side and then cuts a short of a length ball to point
a full ball, Praveen makes room and drives it through extra cover
he wanted to drive straight but got an inside edge towards square leg
a slower ball in the blockhole, Praveen plays it towards midwicket
a quick bouncer, 141 kph, Praveen ducks
caught at long off! The ball bobbled out of Bravo's hands but he was good enough to hold on. Harris lofted a length ball on the up and simply did not hit it far enough
Praveen gets hit on the toe by a superb yorker from Morris, and gets a leg bye behind point
Bravo bowls another slower one and hits the outside edge, the ball falls well short of the keeper

caught by Vijay running to his right at long off! Bravo fooled Chawla with the slower offcutter and the batsman spooned his lofted shot high over extra cover. Vijay covered a lot of ground and judged the catch well
Chawla tries to steer the ball towards third man but is beaten by the extra bounce from a good length
Chawla has a slog, trying to hit the ball down the ground, but missed

Morris has taken his first catch in the IPL. Sathish swung a length ball from outside off, but hit it straight to Morris, who had to move very little to get into position and take the catch at deep square leg
Sathish makes room and drives the ball through cover for a single
defended off the back foot towards point
what a shot that is! Chawla has just driven a length ball on the up through extra cover, superbly timed and played with flourish.

that's Morris' first wicket in the IPL! Mahmood went back to pull a short of a length ball and was rushed for time. He mis-timed it towards midwicket where Ashwin dived to his left to take a sharp, low catch
short ball and the batsman pulls along the ground to square leg
short of a length and much quicker, Mahmood jumps back and plays the ball down on the off side
what's happened there? Mahmood wanted to whip off the front foot on the leg side but he got a leading edge that flew towards third man, Nannes ran to his left but could not reach it
a slower one outside off, Mahmood moves forward and drops he ball with soft hands on the off side
steered from the crease towards third man
he's backed away, made room, and cut a short of a length ball fine to the third man boundary
good length outside off stump, played from the crease towards point
a slower ball outside off stump, steered towards third man
a terrible shot. Gurkeerat tried to sweep that from so far outside off stump and the top edge flew towards short fine leg where Nannes took the catch
worked off the pads towards short fine leg
a high full toss outside off stump, the legbreak that did not land. The batsman drags it from outside off towards deep midwicket

a terrific effort on the boundary, but it's gone for four! Gurkeerat lofted the ball on the up towards long off. Bravo was wide on the boundary and he sprinted to his right, reaching the ball at full pace and jumping to try and catch it with one hand. He got a hand to it but could not hold on, the ball bounced inside the boundary and went over. Very few fielders would have got to that ball like Bravo did. He was so quick
nudged off the pads through square leg
Mahmood leans forward to his first ball and drives through cover
Hussey's gone! Caught by Bravo at long off. Hussey cleared his front foot to try and loft over the leg side but Ashwin had bowled the carrom ball and Hussey ended up slicing it straight to long off
makes room once again by moving outside leg but Jadeja manages to cramp him, played towards cover
he hard and straight back at the bowler
Gurkeerat made room by moving towards leg, the bowler followed him, he works it off the pads in front of square
Gurkeerat goes back and punches straight past the bowler for two more
played through midwicket for a single
that's a sensational cut shot. It was a quicker ball from Jadeja, angling into off and middle. Hussey went back, made room by exposing his stumps and cut it between two fielders in the point region
driven along the ground towards long off
played off the back foot towards backward point
another short ball, this time Gurkeerat makes room and slaps it over extra cover, hitting it hard and flat towards the boundary
a short ball and Gurkeerat pulls off the back foot towards the fielder at deep midwicket
a full delivery and it's been driven towards long on for a single
Hussey whips a full ball from his crease through square leg
driven off the back foot towards the fielder on the cover boundary
dabbed off the back foot behind point
nudged from the crease towards cover. Hussey began to run but was sent back
a superb shot! Gurkeerat gets down low and sweeps the ball powerfully from outside off to the square leg boundary
hit powerfully towards deep square leg, where the fielder covers good ground and dives to prevent the boundary
swept towards long leg for one more
played to extra cover for a single

he misses the sweep and gets hit on the pad, the ball goes towards the off side and they attempt a single. Hussey was gone by miles had Dhoni who ran to the ball and threw at the stumps scored a direct hit. Instead they got overthrows
Gurkeerat strides forward and drives fluently towards deep cover
defended off the front foot towards cover
cut hard off the back foot through point
Hussey works the ball off his pads towards midwicket, where Raina dives to his right and cuts it off
stays back and drives the fuller ball past the bowler towards mid-on
that's the first six of the innings, the length was too short and Hussey was ready and waiting, he pulled it powerfully several rows back over the deep midwicket boundary
short ball, Hussey shaped up to pull but then avoided it
he's lucky to get away with that one on the pads, Hussey didn't make proper contact with the glance
Hussey stays back to a good length ball and plays towards midwicket
short of a length, climbing on the batsman, Gurkeerat gets on top of the bounce and fends it down on the leg side
Gurkeerat tries to paddle sweep but the ball goes off his pad towards short fine leg
stays back in his crease and plays the ball with the angle into him through midwicket
pushed off the front foot towards long-on
defended towards short cover, Jadeja runs across to field
Gurkeerat stays in his crease and steers towards short third man
nudged off the pads from the crease in front of square leg, Dhoni runs after the ball
driven off the front foot towards mid on
another one down leg side, the second wide of the over
that's a dangerous shot, cutting from middle and leg towards backward point
punched off the front foot towards cover point where Raina dives to his left to cut it off
a short ball and it's marginally down leg side, Gurkeerat moved inside the line and lifted his arms out of the way
a slower one outside off and Hussey steers off the back foot towards third man
a terrific drive! Hussey stays so well balanced in his crease and drills a length ball through extra cover
short of a length on the pads, nudged towards square leg

that's a rubbish ball, so short, and Vohra went back and pulled in the air towards cow corner, where he had hit his previous boundary. But Dhoni had moved a fielder there, and Hussey settled under the ball and caught it a couple of yards inside the rope. He could have hit it anywhere and he picked out the fielder
defended on the off side
Vohra plonks his foot forward and slog sweeps Jadeja with the angle into him from round the wicket to the cow corner boundary, no one in the deep there
played off the back foot through point
pushed from the crease towards point
bowled slowly on middle stump, driven towards mid off for one more
played towards Vijay again, for a single

Vijay's dropped a sitter at mid-off! Well he didn't really get to it, misjudged it totally. Hussey backed away and slapped another ball flat and straight towards mid off. Vijay should have moved forward but he didn't. And by the time he did, it was too late to get his hands properly under the ball
Hussey backs away outside leg stump, manufacturing room to slap the ball from in front of his stumps through cover, the length was short enough to allow such a shot
pushes Hussey on to the back foot with his length and pace, the line is a bit too straight, Hussey goes back and blocks
defended on the back foot
Vohra tried to cut that one without moving his feet and was beaten by the extra bounce
short of a length, pitching in line with the stumps and slanting across the right-hander, Vohra pulls his bat inside the line of the ball and lets it go
worked off the back foot towards square leg
that is some shot, he stayed back to a good length ball and used the width outside off, clearing his front foot and driving on the up, past the fielder at mid-off and to the extra cover boundary
a bouncer and Hussey ducks under it
he stays back to a full ball and taps it towards mid-off and runs, Badrinath dived but wasn't able to cut it off cleanly
driven off the back foot towards cover point
shot! Vohra picks the fuller ball off his pads and sends it soaring towards deep midwicket with a clean swing. Timed this one well, he did
short ball and Vohra is quickly into position to pull over the infield, he didn't time it too well
shot! Vohra moved forward to a fuller ball and drove it on the up between midwicket and mid-on, timing it well enough to beat the chasing fielder
I thought there was a noise as the ball passed the bat but no one on the field did. Morris bounced a short of a length ball past Vohra's bat
drifts on to the pads this time, Hussey stays back and nudges the ball off his pads towards midwicket
and it's a good one, spearing into the blockhole, Hussey digs it out on the off side
defended off the back foot on the off side

caught at square leg! Mandeep tried to hook but the short ball was on to him far too quickly, the top edge lobbed tamely towards square leg and Bravo ran a few paces to his right and held a comfortable catch
Vohra taps the ball off his pads and runs a single as the ball goes towards midwicket

Michael Hussey was just speaking to the commentators on TV but he was focussed enough to dive to his left at a deepish leg gully and catch Gilchrist's whip off the pads. He was placed there precisely for that shot and it's worked. The ball traveled flat and fast to Hussey, who had it covered
played with softer hands towards point for a single
width outside off stump and Mandeep slashes, carving the ball in the air towards third man
what a cover drive that is, it was in the slot outside off stump and Gilchrist brought his bat down like the swing of a rapier, sending the ball screaming across the outfield
Gilchrist tried to play that on the off side but mis-timed it on the leg side
Gilchrist stays back and pokes tentatively outside off stump, the ball flies off the outside edge to the third man boundary
Mandeep tries to whip the ball off his hips but misses and gets hit on the thigh
Gilchrist goes back to a good length ball and taps it towards extra cover, takes a quick single on those 41 year old legs
length ball on off and middle, Mandeep works the ball behind square for a single
Gilchrist jumps back and across his stumps to defend a good length ball towards mid-on, he thought about a single and then decided against it
waits for the ball to angle across him and then opens the face to steer towards third man
fuller delivery outside off stump, Mandeep leans into the cover drive but can't beat the infield
he lets another one go outside off stump, two in a row, it's unlikely there will be a third
fuller ball, slanting across the right-hander, pitching outside off stump, Mandeep lets it go
and they are roaring now, after Mandeep went back to a short of a length ball and punched it fluently through extra cover. He's a local boy too
the winning run is a single to long off, it's a ten-wicket victory, as emphatic as they come in T20 cricket
he's launched that high and far over the square leg boundary. Hussey was on the front foot and he was in great position to hammer the short ball for six
Hussey drives a good length ball towards long on
110 kph, Vijay dabs the slower ball close on the off side and jogs the single to reach his fifty
stays back to this one and dabs the ball in front of point for a single
Hussey charges, gets to the pitch of the ball and launches it over the long-on boundary. Measured at 84 metres, that was
Hussey moves forward and cuts the ball to the man at gully
short ball and Hussey swivels and pulls the ball square of the fielder at deep midwicket, finding the gap once again
that's the first six of the innings. Vijay got under a length ball, made room and lofted through the line, hitting cleanly over long off. And on that note, the players will take a time out.
Hussey tried to pull that as well but the ball was so slow that he had nearly finished the shot by the time it reached him. It hit the top edge and lobbed tamely on the off side
nudged off the pads behind square for two more
short ball, Hussey is back in a flash and pulls the ball so powerfully that it beats the fielder at deep midwicket
a full ball and Hussey sweeps into the gap at deep backward square leg
short of a length and Vijay pulls the ball towards long on
a slower ball on middle stump, Vijay stays in his crease and defends on the off side, they run a quick single
short ball and Hussey pulls from middle and off line towards deep square leg
pulled off the back foot to deep midwicket
worked off the pads through square leg and Vijay sprints back for the second to bring up CSK's 100
Vijay made room by moving towards leg and had to wait for Mahmood's back-of-the-hand slower ball to reach him, he cuts it towards point
another short ball and Hussey moves forward before transferring his weight on to the back foot and pulling along the ground to deep midwicket
played off the pads behind square for a single
too short, Hussey goes back in a flash and pulls the ball into the gap on the square leg boundary
Hussey is cramped for room as he cuts and gets a bottom edge into the ground near his feet, the ball misses the stumps
driven off the front foot to long off
Vijay plays the ball to wide long on
Hussey moves forward and hits the ball flat over the infield at midwicket
a half-volley on the pads, Vijay clips it firmly to the square leg boundary, another loose ball from Harris
played off the back foot towards point
short ball and Hussey swivels on the front foot and rolls his wrists as he pulls the ball along the ground to the backward square leg boundary to bring up his fifty
Vijay backs away and cuts a length ball from off stump through point
defended from the crease on the off side
poor line and length, on the pads, Vijay glances to the fine leg boundary
played behind point for a single
that's the googly and Vijay was out of his crease and beaten, the ball thudded into his pad
played back to the bowler
Hussey moves forward and drives along the ground to long off, Harris fields again
full and straight, Vijay moves forward and drives along the ground to long on
tossed up outside off stump, driven off the front foot towards cover
Hussey drives off the front foot at one that angles into him but holds its line, he gets beaten
good length angling into the left-hander from round the wicket, Hussey stays in his crease and pushes on the off side
length on the pads, Vijay stays in his crease and works the ball through square
Vijay stays back and defends on the leg side
worked off the hips behind square
a superb drive, Harris overpitched and Hussey met it on the front foot and played a flowing drive between the bowler and mid-off
nudged from the crease in front of point for more runs
tossed up outside off, Vijay does not leave his crease while driving through point
wide outside off stump, Hussey goes right back and cuts in front of point
waits in his crease and closes the face of the bat to play behind square
payed from the crease on the off side
played off the back foot towards point
Vijay backs away outside leg, Awana follows him with a full ball and Vijay golf swings it through midwicket
this time there's not as much width and Hussey cuts straight to point, Kings XI concede an overthrow
he does not learn, Awana bowls length wide outside off, Hussey gets on to the front foot and cuts hard, beating point with ease
he's blitzed that though point. Far too much room outside off and Hussey did not hold back, square cutting off the front foot with power
a short ball and Hussey has pulled it off the front foot, flat over the infield at midwicket
worked off the pads towards deep square leg
played to point for a single

now Gilchrist's missed a stumping! Vijay came out of his crease and was beaten by a flat ball that skidded straight on. Gilchrist did not collect cleanly and by the time he broke the stumps, Vijay was back
driven to long on for a single
put down! Hussey chipped the ball back to the bowler, quite tamely. Chawla stooped towards his left and shelled it. That was quite easy
Vijay steps out, Chawla shortens his length, and Vijay defends on the off side
defended back to the bowler
good length on leg and middle, flicked in front of square and they sprint back for the second
a short ball and Vijay pulls powerfully towards deep midwicket
defended from the crease towards midwicket
punched off the back foot towards point
short of a length and down leg side, Gilchrist dives full length to prevent four byes. An athletic effort

good length on off and middle, Hussey punches towards mid-off and runs. Harris sprints in, picks up cleanly and throws down the stumps at the bowler's end. Hussey had dived spectacularly, he should have been out by a foot or two but his full length dive nearly took him to safety. But not quite. The bat was on the line as the bails came off. Or was it? It's touch and go. So close. The third umpire is taking ages. Hussey gets the benefit of the doubt. He's a lucky man.
David Hussey dives to his left at gully to stop a firm cut from his brother
flicked off the pads in front of square, the running between the wickets is quick
Hussey drives to long on for a single that takes his IPL run tally to 1000
Hussey has more width to work with and this time he finds the gap, going back and cutting through cover point, poor line
a stunning stop at cover. Hussey's drive was nearly about to pierce the infield at cover but Mandeep dived to his right and brought the ball down with one hand
pushed towards mid-on, Hussey says no to the single
Hussey stays in his crease and cuts towards point
the short of a length ball bounces on Vijay, who gets beaten as he plays from his crease
Vijay moves forward and across to turn a length ball off his pads towards square leg, where Gurkeerat fumbles
good length on middle and off, defended from the crease
short of a length outside off, played off the back foot towards cover
played on the leg side for a single

bottom edged and four! Hussey tried to cut a ball that angled across him and got a thick under edge that went right past the stumps. Gilchrist was wrong footed because he was going towards the off side
terrific timing, Vijay came forward to a length ball and punched it on the up, piercing the in field at extra cover
too straight, and Vijay stays in his crease and flicks towards deep square
worked off the pads towards square leg
Hussey stays back and opens the face late to steer the ball towards wide third man, the Hussey express steams back for the second
Awana lets the ball go through his legs at mid-on, Vijay stayed in his crease and flicked the ball towards mid-on, really sloppy fielding
good length on off stump, Vijay pushes forward and blocks
Hussey played away from his body at one that swung away from him and the outside edge nearly carried to his brother at a wide second slip
a sublime drive wide of mid-off, Hussey came smoothly on to the front foot and used the width to drive along the ground through extra cover
Hussey stays in his crease and defends a good length ball back down the pitch, mid-off fields
pushed from the crease towards extra cover for a tight single
tight line and length on off stump, 128 kph, defended on the front foot
good length on middle stump, Vijay stays in his crease and flicks towards midwicket
played off the front foot towards point for a single
good length on off stump, Vijay moves forward, gets behind the line and defends on the off side
Hussey closed the face to a fuller delivery and the outside edge went towards third man
Hussey gets beaten as he defends inside the line, the ball pitched around off and slanted across the left-hander
good length, pitching close to off stump and moving away as Hussey shoulders arms
a full ball with some swing away from Vijay, who pushes at the ball and gets a thick outside edge through point
good length, pitching outside off and moving away from Hussey, who lets it go
much too wide outside off, meat and mead for Hussey, who stays back and cuts through point. He'll hit you there in his sleep
pitches on a good length outside off and seams away from Hussey, who lets it go
big swing into the right-hander's pads, flicked towards deep square leg
defended on the front foot towards the off side
good length outside off with some shape away from Vijay, who stayed in his crease and played towards cover
the start is poor, a leg-side wide. Vijay tried to glance but the ball was too far away
